newsitem.title: BRAZIL: Brazil to sell Santos port terminal Sept 10--paper.
newsitem.headline: Brazil to sell Santos port terminal Sept 10--paper.

text.p: Brazil is likely to privatize the container terminal at Santos port on September 10, said O Globo newspaper on Monday.
The privatization date depends on National Privatization Council (CND), which is due to meet in the first week of July, according to the paper.
O Globo also said the minimum price, which still has to be set, certainly will be above 100 million reais.

Last week, Planning Minister Antonio Kandir said the sale would be conditional on a sharp reduction in handling charges. He said the aim was to slash container handling charges within two years to 150 reais from about 500 reais per container on average.
